scenes.heading: Building a portfolio that filters for your ideal client

sents.d: Building a portfolio that filters for your ideal client
Show 15–20 of your best images, not everything you've shot.
A portfolio's job is to filter, not to prove range.
Showing every image you've ever taken dilutes your strongest work and confuses potential clients about what you actually specialize in.

scenes.heading: 15–20 images of the work you want

sents.d: Curate 15–20 images that represent the specific style and type of work you want more of, and update the portfolio regularly as your best work improves — older, weaker images should be cut, not just added to.
Organize by category if you shoot more than one niche, so a potential client can quickly find work relevant to what they need.

take: Show only the work you want more of.
